annotations.title: Check share-card tags in pasted HTML (before deploy, localhost, private pages)

description: Use when the share-card tags need checking in HTML that is not public yet: a page being built, a localhost or staging page, a template, or a <head> block the user pasted (signals: "check my meta tags", "are these og tags right", "before I deploy", "Next.js metadata", "index.html head"). Reads the og: and twitter: tags in the pasted HTML with X's documented fallbacks and returns the same result as postcard_check_link_preview: the card each platform will build, problems with fixes (missing og:image or twitter:card, relative image path, title over X's 70 characters, duplicates, name= instead of property=, tags in <body>, a JavaScript app shell with no tags) and a paste-ready <meta> block. The page is not fetched; with fetch_image true, a public absolute image URL is downloaded to read its real size, format and bytes. Example: {"html":"<head><meta property=\"og:title\" content=\"Launch\"><meta property=\"og:image\" content=\"/og.png\"></head>","url":"https://example.com/launch"}. Limits: robots.txt and redirects of the page are not checked (no fetch); without url, relative image paths cannot be resolved.

fetch_image.description: true to download the public og:image / twitter:image and read its real pixel size, format and file size. Default false (nothing is fetched).

html.description: The page HTML, or at least its <head> with the meta tags (up to 400,000 characters).

url.description: Optional address the page will be served at, used to turn relative image paths into full URLs and to compare og:url.
